Frequently Asked Questions

Common Inquiries

How do I get started with Axiom64?
Download Axiom64 from the App Store. Upon first launch, the system will guide you through a brief calibration sequence to establish your baseline decision parameters. No account creation is required to begin using core risk assessment tools.
What data does Axiom64 collect?
Axiom64 is designed with a privacy-first architecture. All decision models and risk computations run locally on your device. We collect no personal identifiers, financial data, or behavioral analytics. Optional anonymous telemetry may be enabled to improve algorithmic precision — this can be disabled at any time in Settings.
Is my business data secure?
Yes. Axiom64 employs on-device processing by default. No data leaves your device unless you explicitly enable optional cloud backup features. All local storage is encrypted using device-level security (Secure Enclave on iOS). We recommend enabling device passcode and biometric authentication for additional protection.
How do I restore my subscription or purchases?
Open Axiom64, navigate to Settings → Account → Restore Purchases. The system will validate your App Store receipts and restore all entitlements. If the issue persists, please contact us via the form below with your App Store receipt for manual verification.
The app is not responding or crashes on launch
Please try the following in order: (1) Force-quit the app and relaunch. (2) Restart your device. (3) Ensure your iOS version is 17.0 or later. (4) Delete and reinstall Axiom64 from the App Store. If the issue persists, contact us below with your device model, iOS version, and a description of the steps leading to the crash.
How can I request a feature or report a bug?
We welcome your feedback. Use the contact form below or email us directly at hexmind.dh@gmail.com. Please include as much detail as possible — screenshots, device information, and steps to reproduce are especially helpful.
